entries.title: Real voice-to-text — talk as long as you want, get clean text
bullets: Replaced the flaky browser mic (Web Speech API, which cut off after a sentence) with OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe (Whisper-class, whisper-1 fallback). Speak for 10–20+ minutes and it transcribes cleanly — Wispr-style.
The mic in both composers (home + working session) now records, shows a live Recording 0:12 timer with a red pulse, and on stop transcribes and drops the text into the box. Tap the square to stop.
New loren-transcribe edge function reuses your existing OpenAI key — no new account. Works across Chrome (webm/opus) and Safari (mp4).
Premium upgrade available later: Deepgram Nova-3 streaming for live word-by-word as you speak (needs a key + a small relay).
entries.bench: loren-transcribe (gpt-4o-transcribe → whisper-1) · MediaRecorder any-length · both composers wired

entries.title: Bigger hero, cleaner rail, and every tool opens its real UI inline
